title: Inventory replenishment with lead time and stockout penalties
text: Daily demand is 4 units for days 1–13, then 5 units for days 14–18. You start with 72 units, can place an order any day which arrives after 3 days with fixed ordering cost 128 plus 16 per unit ordered. Holding cost is 1 per unit per day; stockout cost is 39 per unit unmet demand (lost sales). Additionally, if inventory ever falls below 29, you must place an emergency order of 78 units (arrives in 2 days at premium cost 35). Find the minimum total cost ordering policy under these rules.
